summary: Login page returning 500 error after deployment
resolution: Root cause was a misconfigured session secret after the last deploy. Fixed by restarting the auth service and rotating the session key.

summary: Users unable to log in, session expiring immediately
resolution: Session cookie domain was set incorrectly after a config change. Corrected the domain setting and redeployed auth service.

summary: Payment gateway timing out during checkout
resolution: Upstream payment provider had degraded performance. Added a retry with exponential backoff and increased timeout threshold.

summary: Checkout failing intermittently with gateway timeout
resolution: Connection pool to payment gateway was exhausted under load. Increased pool size and added circuit breaker.

summary: Database connections exhausted during peak hours
resolution: Connection pool limit was too low for peak traffic. Increased max pool size and added monitoring alert for pool saturation.

summary: Production database unresponsive, connection pool full
resolution: A long-running query was holding connections open. Killed the query and added a query timeout policy.

summary: Customer data missing after merging two accounts
resolution: Account merge script had a race condition dropping records. Fixed the script to run merges sequentially with locking.

summary: Email notifications delayed by several hours
resolution: Email queue worker had crashed silently. Added health check and auto-restart for the worker process.

summary: Search results taking too long to load for large datasets
resolution: Missing database index on the search column. Added composite index, reduced query time by 90%.

summary: Search queries timing out on large result sets
resolution: Query lacked pagination, was loading entire dataset. Added server-side pagination and result limiting.

summary: Timezone displayed incorrectly in user activity logs
resolution: Timestamps were stored in local time instead of UTC. Migrated all timestamp storage to UTC with client-side conversion.

summary: Typo found in password reset email template
resolution: Corrected the typo in the email template and redeployed the notification service.
